subsystems.name: Data ingestion and preprocessing
subsystems.role: pulls documents from enterprise systems and turns them into clean, chunked text.
parts: connectors for databases, wikis, file shares, email

subsystems.name: Embedding and indexing
subsystems.role: converts text chunks into vectors and stores them for fast similarity search.

subsystems.name: Retrieval and ranking
subsystems.role: finds the most relevant chunks for a user query.

subsystems.name: Generation and orchestration
subsystems.role: feeds retrieved context to an LLM and produces a grounded answer.

subsystems.name: Guardrails and evaluation
subsystems.role: ensures answers are accurate, safe and compliant.

subsystems.name: Monitoring and feedback
subsystems.role: tracks performance and improves the pipeline over time.

buildSteps.title: Define the use case and data sources
buildSteps.detail: Identify the decision or question the system must support, and list the enterprise repositories (wikis, tickets, contracts) that hold the answers.

buildSteps.title: Connect and ingest data
buildSteps.detail: Use APIs or connectors to pull documents, extract text with parsers and OCR, and attach metadata such as source, date and access level.

buildSteps.title: Chunk and preprocess
buildSteps.detail: Split documents into passages of a few hundred tokens, preserving headings and tables, and remove boilerplate or duplicates.

buildSteps.title: Generate embeddings and build the index
buildSteps.detail: Run each chunk through an embedding model and store the resulting vectors in a vector database, alongside keyword indexes for hybrid search.

buildSteps.title: Implement retrieval and ranking
buildSteps.detail: For each query, rewrite it, fetch candidates via hybrid search, apply metadata filters for permissions, and re-rank with a cross-encoder.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the language model
buildSteps.detail: Build a prompt that includes the user's question and the top-ranked chunks, and call an LLM to generate an answer with citations.

buildSteps.title: Add guardrails and access control
buildSteps.detail: Enforce user permissions at retrieval time, redact sensitive data, and validate answers against retrieved sources before showing them.

buildSteps.title: Deploy, monitor and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Run the pipeline behind an API, log queries and responses, collect user feedback, and retrain or adjust chunking and ranking based on evaluation metrics.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with long context windows
prerequisites.why: they generate fluent answers from retrieved passages; context windows of 128k tokens or more are now common.

prerequisites.tech: Vector databases and approximate nearest neighbour search
prerequisites.why: they allow millisecond-scale similarity search over millions of chunks.
they map semantically similar passages to nearby vectors, which is the core of retrieval.
many systems offer APIs, but unifying permissions and formats across legacy software remains labour-intensive.
the pipeline must not leak documents a user cannot see, requiring tight integration with identity providers.

prerequisites.tech: Evaluation frameworks for retrieval and generation
prerequisites.why: measuring hallucination and relevance is still an active area, with no universal standard.

pathway.milestone: basic RAG for internal knowledge search and customer support
pathway.unlocks: faster answers from existing documents, with citations.

pathway.milestone: advanced RAG with hybrid search, re-ranking and query decomposition
pathway.unlocks: higher accuracy on complex, multi-part questions.

pathway.milestone: agentic RAG that plans, calls tools and iterates
pathway.unlocks: decision support that goes beyond simple lookup.

pathway.milestone: self-improving pipelines that learn from feedback and update indexes automatically
pathway.unlocks: enterprise knowledge systems that stay current with minimal manual tuning.
